northStar: Wàfè helps families turn the life they imagine into the life they live — a private family operating system that connects values, vision and goals to what the household actually does every day, through a morning briefing, an evening check-in and Sunday planning.
principles: Values first, features second: every task, lesson, prayer, purchase and trip can link to a family value and goal.
Private by default, shared on purpose: every record carries visibility and a sensitivity class; guests are granted named objects, never modules.
The loop is the product: morning briefing → do → evening check-in → Sunday planning.
AI is a companion, not a chatbot: grounded in the asking member's own data, proposes rather than acts, always shows sources.
The companion never asks for context the app already holds; it says 'I used…' and 'I can't see that' rather than inventing.
Children get a real product: age-band child mode with feed, My Garden and rewards.
Rituals over streaks: grace days, no sibling leaderboard by default, no loss-aversion mechanics, celebrations on the family timeline.
Calm, not noisy: three reminders then Needs attention; quiet hours defer, never drop; digest above five nudges a day.
Faith is woven, not bolted on: scripture, prayer and giving live in the daily rhythm and the ledger.
Lived-in from the first minute: start from the demo family; value before configuration.
